note: Reel 17: Butter Chicken's Two Inventors. Butter chicken is credited to Kundan Lal: Kundan Lal Gujral (c.1902-1997) or Kundan Lal Jaggi (1924-2018), friends and partners from Peshawar who, after Partition, ran Moti Mahal in Daryaganj, Delhi (Nehru among its diners: Reuters 2024). Their families now run rival chains (Moti Mahal Delux; Daryaganj), and since January 2024 they have been in the Delhi High Court (Rupa Gujral & Ors v Daryaganj Hospitality, CS(COMM) 26/2024; a 2,752-page suit: NPR, Reuters). The Gujrals say Gujral made it in Peshawar to save leftover tandoori chicken in a gravy for the next day; the Jaggis say Jaggi made it in Delhi to stretch a few pieces for late guests (NPR 2024). On 23 Sep 2026 the hearing was deferred to 3 Dec 2026 (Delhi HC order). Facts: docs/research.md. Kokoro af_heart, speed 1.0. Indian names are planned by hand (memory: indian-word-pronunciation): कुंदन लाल [kʊndən laːl] 'KOON-dun LAAL', गुजराल [ɡʊdʒraːl] 'goo-JRAAL', जग्गी [dʒəɡːiː] 'JUG-gee', पेशावर [peːʃaːʋər] 'pay-SHAA-war', मोती महल [moːtiː mɛɦɛl] 'MO-tee MEH-hel', नेहरू [neːɦruː] 'NAY-roo'. The b lines try the other plan, the c lines Kokoro's own (the plain spelling), for the ears to judge.
